value.answer: Glad you reached out. In Toronto, private therapy isn't covered by OHIP, but if you have an employer, its Employee Assistance Program may include some free sessions a year, and private therapists are often covered by extended health plans. For free or cheap options, the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers free short-term CBT for adults with depression and anxiety, Family Service Toronto has sliding-scale fees based on income, and the U of T and TMU training clinics see clients at reduced rates. If things get urgent, ConnexOntario is open 24/7 at 1-866-531-2600.
